subject.title: FailoverError during cli-backend turn does not clear stale cliSessionIds from sessions.json, causing infinite retry loop

question: Should the linked PR be accepted as the canonical fix for clearing stale Claude CLI bindings on channel and follow-up `FailoverError` paths?
rationale: The fix is narrow and source-backed, but it intentionally changes persisted session-state cleanup behavior for failed reused CLI turns, so a maintainer should accept the session-state policy before merge.

options.title: Accept linked PR as the fix
options.body: Land the guarded channel/follow-up cleanup after maintainer review confirms parity with the command-attempt stale-session cleanup behavior.

options.title: Narrow the failure policy
options.body: Ask the PR author to limit or adjust the failure classes if maintainers do not want every proposed lifecycle error to invalidate a reused Claude CLI binding.

options.title: Reject and keep this issue open
options.body: Close the linked PR and keep this issue as the canonical bug if maintainers want a different cleanup location or recovery policy.

recommendation.title: Accept linked PR as the fix
recommendation.body: Land the guarded channel/follow-up cleanup after maintainer review confirms parity with the command-attempt stale-session cleanup behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent history place this handle closest to the auto-reply CLI lifecycle and session helper surfaces that would change.
